title: centaurea cinerea
intro: Centaurea cinerea, commonly known as White Knapweed, is a plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae) that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating pain, due to its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea cinerea include its ability to act as an antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antiseptic, making it useful in wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of Centaurea cinerea include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
